race.description: Worlds Best Hoof Oil Vicbred Voucher Pace
race.comment: MISS ADDI (4) was once again right in the mix last start when runner-up over 1710m at Ballarat, beaten 2.25 metres. Finds a tougher race but she has the ability to go one better. MASTER LOUEY (1) registered yet another strong performance last start when he battled on bravely to just miss out over 2240m at Melton, adding to a string of recent minor placings. Has the benefit of a good draw. Has the class to take this out. HILTONS SPIRIT (2) must be considered after he finished third over 2240m at Melton two-and-a-half weeks ago. KEAYANG SANTIAGO (3) was safely held last time out at the second run back from a spell. Open to plenty of improvement with a good draw assisting his chances.
